description: The full ASCII table, with the control codes explained rather than left blank. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

includeExtended.description: Also include codes 128 to 255, read as ISO-8859-1 (Latin-1). ASCII proper stops at 127, so a search for a higher code finds nothing unless this is true.

search.description: What to look up: a single character ("A"), a decimal code ("65"), hex ("0x41", "U+0041", "\x41"), binary ("0b01000001"), octal ("0o101"), an HTML entity ("&"), an abbreviation ("LF") or part of a name ("line feed", "sep"). Numbers return one entry; names return every match, best first. Plain digits are always decimal. Empty (the default) returns the whole table.

name: ascii_table
